title: Anduril raises USD 2.5bn at a USD 30.5bn valuation in a round led by Founders Fund
summary: TechCrunch reported the funding round for the defence technology company.

title: Apple researchers report reasoning models' accuracy collapses past a complexity threshold on puzzle tests
summary: The paper 'The Illusion of Thinking' found large reasoning models cut their reasoning effort on harder puzzles.

title: NYT reports Meta is creating a new AI lab to pursue superintelligence
summary: The New York Times reported the plan on 10 June.

title: Disney and Universal sue Midjourney for copyright infringement in US federal court
summary: The suit in the Central District of California is the first by major Hollywood studios against a generative AI developer.

title: Fortune reports an 'EchoLeak' flaw in Microsoft 365 Copilot could expose data through prompt injection
summary: The vulnerability let a crafted input pull data from other contexts of the assistant.

title: Google AI Overview reportedly named Airbus instead of Boeing after the Air India Flight 171 crash
summary: The AI Incident Database logs the incorrect AI-generated answer about the aircraft maker.

title: Meta announces USD 14.3bn investment for 49% of Scale AI and recruits its chief executive
summary: Bloomberg reported Scale AI chief executive Alexandr Wang would join Meta's AI unit.

title: Unknown actor reportedly used AI voice cloning to impersonate US Secretary of State Marco Rubio
summary: The AI Incident Database logs voice and text messages sent to contact officials.

title: Officials reportedly shared a Veo 3-generated video backing Vice President Sara Duterte during her impeachment
summary: The AI Incident Database logs the video as AI-generated content circulated by officials.

title: Microsoft AI preprint reports its MAI-DxO orchestrator reached 80% diagnostic accuracy on a sequential-diagnosis benchmark
summary: The paper introduces the SDBench benchmark, and the orchestrator reached that accuracy when paired with OpenAI's o3.

title: US judge rules training an LLM on lawfully acquired books is fair use but keeping pirated copies is not
summary: Judge William Alsup issued the ruling in Bartz v. Anthropic.

title: Google DeepMind introduces AlphaGenome, a model that predicts genomic activity from long DNA sequences
summary: The bioRxiv preprint describes predicting thousands of functional genomic tracks from 1 megabase of DNA.

title: Ukrinform reports AI-generated audio impersonating commander Andrii Biletskyi spread by Russian Telegram channels
summary: Verification reportedly found the voice synthetic; the clip falsely claimed authorities hide fallen soldiers' identities to withhold compensation.

title: South African legal team reportedly admits an AI tool produced non-existent case law in an urgent court filing
summary: The AI Incident Database logs the admission by the team of Northbound Processing.
